periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is angled approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downward towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-oblique height significantly exceeding horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering observed at the lower-inner margin of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape profile along the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal-lateral torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation; the cranial gap between ears is approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded curvature across the superior boundary of both visible ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable brownish-tan tinting on the fur across the lumbar and rump regions compared to the white fur of the neck.
